note: City of Sleepy Eye park on the north shore of Sleepy Eye Lake, off Hwy 4. 24 back-in sites in a wooded loop set back from the shore, plus two camper cabins; fishing docks, public boat launch, kayak and paddleboard rental, and a paved trail around the lake. Payment is not refunded. Distinct from 'Sportsman Park Camping' in Zumbro Falls. --Claude
summary: City page + city rec1 catalog read: 24 back-in electric (20/30/50 A) + water sites, no sewer at sites (dump station), showers; $32 for sites 1-16, 17-24 'Multiple Rates' unread; online booking through the city's rec1 (account needed to book), 7-night permit limit renewable. Sites 8 -> 24, sewer true -> cleared, platform phone -> operator. Season not stated anywhere official (stored derived mid-May to mid-Sep left). Not waterfront kept; pin OK.
